children: Financial conditions are likely to remain biased toward tightening until core PCE inflation comes under control, making it harder to take an outright bullish view on markets, particularly small-cap stocks, according to 22V Research.

The firm's chart compares the Fed FCI-G simulation with core PCE inflation from 2000 through 2026. The latest portion of the chart shows the financial-conditions measure below its zero line while core PCE remains around 3%.

22V Research said financial conditions were biased toward tightening while core PCE remained elevated, adding that a decline in inflation would make it easier to take a bullish view of markets, particularly small caps.

The chart also reproduced Federal Reserve language stating that policymakers had removed "a dose of accommodation" so financial and credit conditions would be more consistent with the Fed's objective of ensuring that underlying inflation was moving toward its goal with sufficient speed.
The chart showed a -1.8% correlation between the Fed FCI-G simulation and core PCE over the period displayed.

title: Tighter financial conditions could keep markets cautious until inflation cools
